fuel_consumption.source_quote: Our 2009 forecasted mainline and Express fuel consumption is approximately 1.44 billion gallons, and a one cent per gallon increase in aviation fuel price results in a $14 million annual increase in expense, excluding the impact of hedge transactions.

instrument_type_details.notes: No premium (costless) collar transactions on heating oil futures. Deeply out-of-the-money as fuel prices collapsed. Net liability $375M at December 31, 2008. No new fuel hedge transactions entered since Q3 2008. 10% heating oil price change would change fair value by ~$30M.

warnings: Stopped entering new fuel hedge transactions in Q3 2008. Existing hedges (collars) are deeply out-of-the-money due to fuel price collapse. Net liability of $375M on remaining 2009 hedges. Hedges represent large liability due to high collar floors vs collapsed market prices.

throughput.source_quote: Fuel consumption (gallons in millions): 1,494 (2008 Total Mainline and Express)
